punchline: Kotter saw capable staff executives fail at leading change because they were not line managers.
thirty_sec: John Kotter says change rarely starts with a crowd: often it begins with one or two people. The successful ones build a coalition of 3 to 5 in year one, growing to 20 to 50 in big companies, with titles, expertise, reputation and relationships, sometimes a union leader or a customer. Led by a staff executive rather than a line manager, they stalled.
